name: schomburg-in-taiwan-by-good-startup
description: Schomburg in Taiwan by Good Startup — SCHOMBURG application guides — six interactive construction-chemistry guides (crack injection, concrete restoration, mineral waterproofing, crystalline waterproofing, crystalline admixture, protective flooring) with hands-on 3D simulators, document generation (quotes, method statements, specifications, submittals, comparisons) and the Köln training game. One self-contained HTML page in English, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) and German.
author: Good Startup LTD. (好時新創有限公司)

scripts.test:game: node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/ui_a_desk.json && node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/ui_a_phone.json && node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/col4.json && node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/smooth1.json && node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/gfx5.json && node qa/kplay.js qa/scenarios/indoor1.json
